title: Voice Change — Detailed Rules & Structures
lede: একাডেমির হ্যান্ডনোট অনুযায়ী ৩৫টি নিয়ম — ৫টি মৌলিক পরিবর্তন, ৮টি tense-ভিত্তিক structure, special, advanced ও expert rules, প্রতিটির structure ও উদাহরণসহ।

objectives.t: Say the five basic moves without looking
objectives.d: Object→Subject, be verb, V3, by, Subject→Object

objectives.t: Write the be verb for all eight tenses
objectives.d: is → is being → has been → was → was being → had been → will be → will have been

objectives.t: Handle the sentences that break the pattern
objectives.d: Imperative, interrogative, double object, reflexive, quasi-passive

objectives.t: Use the right preposition after V3

rules.name: Voice কী, আর ৫টি মৌলিক পরিবর্তন
rules.bn: Voice হলো Verb-এর গঠন, যা দিয়ে বোঝা যায় Subject নিজে কাজ করে নাকি অন্যের কাজ তার ওপর এসে পড়ে। **Active** — Subject নিজে কাজ করে। **Passive** — Object-এর কাজ Subject-এর ওপর এসে পড়ে।
rules.formula: ১. Object → Subject · ২. Tense ও Person অনুযায়ী be verb · ৩. মূল verb-এর V3 · ৪. Preposition (প্রায়ই by) · ৫. Subject → Object
rules.ex: **A:** I eat rice. → **P:** Rice ==is eaten by== me.

rules.name: Present Indefinite Tense
rules.bn: Subject ও Object স্থান বদলাবে, আর tense অনুযায়ী **am / is / are** বসবে।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + am / is / are + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** He plays football. → **P:** Football ==is played by== him.

rules.name: Present Continuous Tense
rules.bn: Continuous-এ **being** যোগ হয় — am being / is being / are being।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + am being / is being / are being + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** She is singing a song. → **P:** A song ==is being sung by== her.

rules.name: Present Perfect Tense
rules.bn: Perfect-এ **been** যোগ হয় — have been / has been।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + have been / has been + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** They have done the work. → **P:** The work ==has been done by== them.

rules.name: Past Indefinite Tense
rules.bn: Past Indefinite-এ **was / were** বসবে।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + was / were + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** I wrote a letter. → **P:** A letter ==was written by== me.

rules.name: Past Continuous Tense
rules.bn: **was being / were being** — নতুন subject অনুযায়ী।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + was being / were being + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** He was reading a book. → **P:** A book ==was being read by== him.

rules.name: Past Perfect Tense
rules.bn: Past Perfect-এ সবসময় **had been**।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + had been + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** We had won the match. → **P:** The match ==had been won by== us.

rules.name: Future Indefinite Tense
rules.bn: **shall be / will be** — নতুন subject অনুযায়ী।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + shall be / will be + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** I will help you. → **P:** You ==will be helped by== me.

rules.name: Future Perfect Tense
rules.bn: **shall have been / will have been** বসবে।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + shall have been / will have been + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** He will have finished it. → **P:** It ==will have been finished by== him.

rules.name: Modal Verbs (can, could, should, must, may, might)
rules.bn: যেকোনো Modal verb থাকলে তার সাথে শুধু একটি **be** যুক্ত করতে হয়।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + Modal + be + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** You must do this. → **P:** This ==must be done by== you.

rules.name: Imperative Sentence (আদেশ, নিষেধ)
rules.bn: মূল Verb দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হলে **Let** বসে। Negative হলে **Let not** বসে।
rules.formula: Let + Object + be + V3
rules.ex: **A:** Open the door. → **P:** ==Let the door be opened==.

rules.name: Imperative with ‘Let’
rules.bn: Let-এর পর **me / him / them** থাকলে সেগুলো **by**-এর পর অপরিবর্তিত বসে।
rules.formula: Let + Object + be + V3 + by + Pronoun(Object)
rules.ex: **A:** Let him do the work. → **P:** Let the work ==be done by him==.

rules.name: Interrogative Sentence (প্রশ্নবোধক)
rules.bn: Auxiliary verb বাক্যের শুরুতে আসবে। **Who** থাকলে **By whom** এবং **Whom** থাকলে **Who** দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হয়।
rules.formula: Who → By whom · Whom → Who
rules.ex: **A:** Who broke the glass? → **P:** ==By whom was the glass broken?==

rules.name: Double Objects (দুটি Object থাকলে)
rules.bn: **ব্যক্তিবাচক** Object-টিকে Subject করা বেশি প্রচলিত। অপর Object-টি V3-এর পর বসে।
rules.formula: Indirect Object (ব্যক্তি) + Be verb + V3 + Direct Object (বস্তু) + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** He gave me a pen. → **P:** ==I was given a pen by== him.

rules.name: Reflexive Pronoun (myself, himself, themselves)
rules.bn: Subject ও Object-এর স্থান পরিবর্তন হয় না। শুধু tense অনুযায়ী **Be verb + V3** বসে।
rules.formula: Subject + Be verb + V3 + by + Reflexive Pronoun
rules.ex: **A:** He killed himself. → **P:** He ==was killed by himself==.

rules.name: Quasi-Passive Verb
rules.bn: গঠন Active কিন্তু অর্থ Passive হলে **When it is** ব্যবহার করে বা সরাসরি করা যায়।
rules.formula: Sub + Be verb + Adjective + when + it is / they are + V3
rules.ex: **A:** Honey tastes sweet. → **P:** Honey ==is sweet when it is tasted==.

rules.name: Appropriate Prepositions (by-এর পরিবর্তে অন্য শব্দ)
rules.bn: সব verb-এর পরে **by** বসে না — **know → to, satisfy → with, shock → at, contain → in** বসে।
rules.formula: V3 + (to / with / at / in) + Subject(Object)
rules.ex: **A:** His behaviour shocked me. → **P:** I ==was shocked at== his behaviour.

rules.name: Infinitive (to + V1)
rules.bn: Active-এ **to + V1** থাকলে Passive-এ **to be + V3** হয়ে যায়।
rules.formula: … + to be + V3 + …
rules.ex: **A:** I have to do this work. → **P:** This work ==has to be done by== me.

rules.name: Factitive Object (make, call, elect, select)
rules.bn: অতিরিক্ত Object (Factitive) আগের জায়গাতেই থাকে, **ব্যক্তিবাচকটি Subject** হয়।
rules.formula: ব্যক্তিবাচক Object(Subject) + Be verb + V3 + Factitive Object + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** We made him captain. → **P:** He ==was made captain by== us.

rules.name: Group Verbs / Prepositional Verbs
rules.bn: Verb-এর সাথে থাকা Preposition-টি **V3-এর পরপরই** বসাতে হয়।
rules.formula: V3 + Preposition + by + Object
rules.ex: **A:** He laughed at the poor man. → **P:** The poor man ==was laughed at by== him.

rules.name: Complex Sentence (People say / We know)
rules.bn: বাক্যের শুরুতে **It is** বসিয়ে Clause-এর Voice Change করা যায়।
rules.formula: It is said / known / believed + that + …
rules.ex: **A:** People say that he is a liar. → **P:** ==It is said that== he is a liar.

rules.name: Present Participle (Verb + ing)
rules.bn: **-ing** যুক্ত অংশটি V3-এর ঠিক পরেই অপরিবর্তিত অবস্থায় বসে।
rules.formula: Object(Subject) + Be verb + V3 + (Verb+ing) অংশ + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** I saw him reading a book. → **P:** He ==was seen reading== a book by me.

rules.name: Omitted Subject (উহ্য Subject)
rules.bn: Passive-এ **by** না থাকলে Active করার সময় অর্থ বুঝে একটি Subject আনতে হবে — Someone, The police, People।
rules.formula: অর্থবোধক Subject (Someone / The police / People) + Verb + Object
rules.ex: **P:** My pen was stolen. → **A:** ==Someone stole== my pen.

rules.name: Cognate Object
rules.bn: Verb ও Object একই শব্দমূল থেকে এলে তা সাধারণ Object-এর মতোই কাজ করে।
rules.formula: Cognate Object(Subject) + Be verb + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** He ran a race. → **P:** A race ==was run by== him.

rules.name: ‘One should’ দিয়ে শুরু বাক্য
rules.bn: **one's** বাদ দিয়ে মূল Object-টিকে Subject বানাতে হবে।
rules.formula: Object(Subject) + should be + V3
rules.ex: **A:** One should keep one's promise. → **P:** ==Promises should be kept==.

rules.name: Bare Infinitive (make, see, hear, bid)
rules.bn: Active-এ **to** উহ্য থাকলেও Passive-এ **to** বসাতে হয় (Let ছাড়া)।
rules.formula: Object(Subject) + Be verb + V3 + to + Verb1 + …
rules.ex: **A:** I made him do the work. → **P:** He ==was made to do== the work by me.

rules.name: ‘Going to’ যুক্ত Sentence
rules.bn: **going to** থাকলে তার পর **be + V3** বসাতে হয়।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + am/is/are/was/were + going to be + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** I am going to open a bank. → **P:** A bank ==is going to be opened by== me.

rules.name: Wh-words (What / Which) Object হিসেবে
rules.bn: **What / Which** নিজেই Subject-এর কাজ করে।
rules.formula: What / Which + Be verb + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** What do you want? → **P:** ==What is wanted by you?==

rules.name: ‘Had better / Would rather / Ought to’
rules.bn: এগুলো Modal verb-এর মতো কাজ করে, তাই **be** যুক্ত হয়।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + had better / ought to + be + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** You had better do this. → **P:** This ==had better be done by== you.

rules.name: Compound Sentence (And / But / Or)
rules.bn: উভয় অংশে Object থাকলে **উভয় অংশেরই** Voice Change করতে হয়।
rules.formula: প্রথম অংশের Passive + Conjunction + দ্বিতীয় অংশের Passive
rules.ex: **A:** Do or die. → **P:** ==Let it be done or you will die==.

rules.name: ‘Have / Has / Had’ + to + Verb
rules.bn: Obligation (বাধ্যবাধকতা) বোঝালে **to**-এর পর **be** বসে।
rules.formula: Obj(Sub) + have/has/had + to be + V3 + by + Sub(Obj)
rules.ex: **A:** I have to finish it. → **P:** It ==has to be finished by== me.

rules.name: ‘There’ দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া বাক্য
rules.bn: Infinitive অংশটি (to + V1) পরিবর্তিত হয়ে **to be + V3** হয়।
rules.formula: There + verb + noun + to be + V3
rules.ex: **A:** There is no time to waste. → **P:** There is no time ==to be wasted==.

rules.name: ‘It is high time’
rules.bn: Clause-টির Voice change করে **Past subjunctive** form-এ লিখতে হয়।
rules.formula: It is high time + Object(Subject) + were + V3
rules.ex: **A:** It is high time we changed it. → **P:** It is high time it ==was changed by== us.

rules.name: Causative Verbs (Have / Get)
rules.bn: Have বা Get-এর পর **বস্তু** থাকলে Verb-টি সবসময় **V3** হয়, যা Passive অর্থ দেয়।
rules.formula: Subject + have/get + বস্তুবাচক Object + V3
rules.ex: **A:** I had the mechanic repair my car. → **P:** I had my car ==repaired by== the mechanic.

rules.name: Gerund (Love, Like, Hate, Remember + V-ing)
rules.bn: **Verb + ing**-কে Passive করতে **being + V3** ব্যবহার করতে হয়।
rules.formula: Subject + love/like/hate + Object + being + V3
rules.ex: **A:** He likes people praising him. → **P:** He likes ==being praised by== people.

rules.name: Imperative Sentence-এ ‘Please / Kindly’
rules.bn: **Please** বা **Kindly** থাকলে বাক্যের শুরুতে **‘You are requested to’** বসে।
rules.formula: You are requested to + V1 + Object
rules.ex: **A:** Please give me water. → **P:** ==You are requested to== give me water.

drills.title: Practice Set 1 — আটটি Tense
drills.intro: প্রথমে tense বলো, তারপর be verb — তারপর পুরো বাক্য।

items.ans: Football is played by him.
A song is being sung by her.
The work has been done by them.
A letter was written by me.
A book was being read by him.
The match had been won by us.
You will be helped by me.
It will have been finished by him.
items.why: Future Perfect → will have been + V3। (নিয়ম ০৮)

drills.title: Practice Set 2 — Special Rules (৯-১৬)
drills.intro: Modal, Imperative, প্রশ্ন, দুই Object — গঠন আলাদা, ধাপ একই।

items.ans: This must be done by you.
Let the door be opened.
Let the work be done by him.
items.why: Let-এর পর pronoun by-এর পরে অপরিবর্তিত। (নিয়ম ১১)

items.ans: By whom was the glass broken?
I was given a pen by him.
He was killed by himself.
Honey is sweet when it is tasted.
I was shocked at his behaviour.

drills.title: Practice Set 3 — Advanced Rules (১৭-২৫)
drills.intro: এখান থেকেই বোর্ডের কঠিন বাক্যগুলো আসে।

items.q: I have to do this work.
items.ans: This work has to be done by me.
He was made captain by us.

items.q: He laughed at the poor man.
items.ans: The poor man was laughed at by him.

items.q: People say that he is a liar.
items.ans: It is said that he is a liar.

items.q: I saw him reading a book.
items.ans: He was seen reading a book by me.
Someone stole my pen.
items.why: by নেই → অর্থবোধক Subject আনতে হবে। (নিয়ম ২২)

items.ans: A race was run by him.
Promises should be kept.

items.q: I made him do the work.
items.ans: He was made to do the work by me.
items.why: Bare infinitive → Passive-এ to ফিরে আসে। (নিয়ম ২৫)

drills.title: Practice Set 4 — Pro & Expert Rules (২৬-৩৫)
drills.intro: শেষের দশটি — এগুলো পারলে যেকোনো বাক্য পারবে।

items.q: I am going to open a bank.
items.ans: A bank is going to be opened by me.
What is wanted by you?
This had better be done by you.
Let it be done or you will die.
It has to be finished by me.
items.why: have to → has to be + V3। (নিয়ম ৩০)

items.q: There is no time to waste.
items.ans: There is no time to be wasted.

items.q: It is high time we changed it.
items.ans: It is high time it was changed by us.

items.q: I had the mechanic repair my car.
items.ans: I had my car repaired by the mechanic.
He likes being praised by people.
You are requested to give me water.

extras.title: Tense → Be verb — আটটি structure এক পাতায়

rows: am being / is being / are being + V3
A song is being sung by her.
The work has been done by them.
A letter was written by me.
A book was being read by him.
The match had been won by us.
You will be helped by me.
shall have been / will have been + V3
It will have been finished by him.

extras.note: Present Perfect Continuous ও Future Continuous-এর Passive হয় না — প্রশ্নে এলে বাক্যটি অপরিবর্তিত রাখো।

extras.title: Pronoun পরিবর্তন — Subject থেকে Object
by-এর পরিবর্তে অন্য preposition — নিয়ম ১৬

rows: I am satisfied with the result.
I was shocked at his behaviour.
Water is contained in the jar.

tips.d: Object সামনে → be verb → ==V3== → by → পুরনো subject-কে object রূপে। ধাপ মুখস্থ থাকলে ৩৫টি নিয়মই সহজ।
write-wrote-==written==, sing-sang-==sung==, break-broke-==broken== — V2 বসিয়ে দিলে পুরো নম্বর যায়।
আদেশে ==Let + object + be + V3==; নিষেধে ==Let not==; আর Please/Kindly থাকলে ==You are requested to==।
==Who → By whom==, ==Whom → Who==; auxiliary verb বাক্যের শুরুতে আসবে।
laugh ==at==, look ==after==, take ==care of== — V3-এর পরপরই preposition-টি রাখতেই হবে, তারপর by।
Intransitive verb-এর (go, come, sleep) object নেই, তাই Passive হয় না।

recap: ৫ ধাপ: Object→Subject, be verb, V3, preposition, Subject→Object।
আট tense-এর be verb: is · is being · has been · was · was being · had been · will be · will have been।
Modal → be + V3; Imperative → Let + be + V3; Please → You are requested to।
Who → By whom; দুই object হলে ব্যক্তিবাচকটি subject; reflexive-এ স্থান বদলায় না।
know→to, satisfy→with, shock→at, contain→in — সব সময় by নয়।
to + V1 → to be + V3; V-ing → being + V3; going to → going to be + V3।
homework: Tense → Be verb চার্টটি না দেখে লিখে আনবে।
Practice Set 3 ও 4-এর ১৯টি বাক্য খাতায় সমাধান করবে।
নিয়ম ১৬-এর চারটি preposition দিয়ে নিজে ৪টি বাক্য বানাবে।
